note: Mainland China: holders of ordinary passports of the 45 countries of the unilateral visa-free policy, Sweden (from 10 November 2025) and Canada and the United Kingdom (from 17 February 2026) may stay up to 30 days without a visa for business, tourism, visits, exchange or transit until 31 December 2026; Russians until 31 December 2027 (extended on 20 May 2026 from the trial that began on 15 September 2025). Nationals of the countries whose mutual visa exemption agreements cover their ordinary passports (the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' table: Albania, Antigua and Barbuda, Armenia, Azerbaijan, the Bahamas, Barbados, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Fiji, Georgia, Grenada, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, the Maldives, Mauritius, Qatar, Samoa, San Marino, Serbia, Seychelles, Singapore, the Solomon Islands, Suriname, Thailand, Tonga, the UAE, Uzbekistan) stay less than 30 days, the table says (some agreements allow more, not modelled). Ecuador's ordinary-passport agreement is suspended on Ecuador's side and Dominica's covers only ordinary passports for public affairs, so both are taken as visas. Taiwan residents enter on the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents, which a first-time visitor can get at any of 100 ports on arrival in about 30 minutes (taken as on arrival). Hong Kong and Macao residents are Chinese nationals (home). The 240-hour visa-free transit and Hainan's own 30-day entry aren't modelled. Every other passport, the United States' included, needs a visa. The policy's notice is read from the Chinese Visa Application Service Center's copy of it; the National Immigration Administration's site refuses this client.

sources.title: Chinese Visa Application Service Center, Bern: Notice on the Extension of the Unilateral Visa-Free Policy (Department of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 3 November 2025)
sources.said: To further facilitate cross-border exchanges between China and foreign countries, the Chinese government has decided to extend the unilateral visa-free policy for nationals of the following countries (listed below) until 24:00 on December 31, 2026. In addition, from November 10, 2025, to December 31, 2026, China will grant visa-free entry to citizens of Sweden. During the validity period of this policy, holders of ordinary passports from the countries concerned may enter China without a visa for purposes of business, tourism, visiting relatives and friends, transit, or exchanges, for a stay of no more than 30 days. ... France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Switzerland, Ireland, Hungary, Austria, Belgium, Luxembourg, Australia, New Zealand, Poland, Portugal, Greece, Cyprus, Slovenia, Slovakia, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Iceland, Monaco, Liechtenstein, Andorra, the Republic of Korea, Bulgaria, Romania, Croatia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Malta, Estonia, Latvia, Japan, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, and Bahrain.

sources.title: Beijing Municipal Government (Xinhua), China to Grant Visa-free Policy to Canadian and British Nationals from February 17 (15 February 2026)
sources.said: To further facilitate cross-border travel, China decides to, starting from February 17, 2026, extend its visa-free policy to ordinary passport holders from Canada and the UK. Ordinary passport holders from the two countries can be exempted from visa to enter China and stay for up to 30 days for business, tourism, family/friends visit, exchange and transit purposes. The policy will be effective until December 31, 2026.

sources.title: Shanghai Municipal Government (China Daily), China extends visa-free policy for Russia to Dec 31, 2027 (20 May 2026)
sources.said: China has decided to extend visa-free entry for Russian citizens until Dec 31, 2027, a spokesman for the Foreign Ministry said on May 20. Ordinary passport holders from Russia can stay visa-free for no more than 30 days for the purposes of business, tourism, visiting family and friends, exchange and transit, Guo Jiakun told a regular news conference.

sources.title: Science and Technology Daily (CCTV), 国台办：20日起大陆可签发一次有效台胞证的口岸数量增加至100个 (19 November 2025)
sources.said: 如果台胞朋友们没有提前办理5年有效台胞证，在抵达上述口岸后，持有效的台湾地区身份证和台湾地区出入境证件、办证照片，可以在口岸出入境管理部门办证窗口申请办理一次有效台胞证，整个流程只需要30分钟。
